Context: 5. Monthly subscription and amount of Insurance Cover:-

- Paras. 5.1 and 5.2.  
The Group to which an employee belongs will be determined with reference to the post held by him on a regular basis on the 1st January.  
- Paras. 5.1 and 5.2.
